payload.description_html: Reconstructed jaw adduc- tor musculature for Plateosaurus (left) and Camarasaurus (right), in right lateral view. Reconstructions are shown at multiple depths, with the removal of successively superfi- cial muscles groups. From top to bottom: all muscles; removal of the m.AMES, removal of the m.AME group, removal of the m.AME, m.PST and m.AMP groups. Scale bars represent 100 mm.
